mapper.select: SELECT a.use_id FROM pf.workspace_tool_shell_admission a JOIN pf.workspace_tool_intent i ON i.operation_id=a.operation_id WHERE a.operation_id=#{operation} AND i.actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND a.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND pf.workspace_shell_stopped_source(a.use_id)

SELECT c.id,c.operation_id,c.space_id,c.workspace_id,c.relative_path path,c.reserved_bytes bytes,c.reserved_version_id version_id,c.asset_id,c.object_key,c.file_operation_id FROM pf.tool_output_capture c JOIN pf.workspace_tool_intent i ON i.operation_id=c.operation_id WHERE c.operation_id=#{operation} AND c.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND i.actor_id=#{actor.userId} ORDER BY c.ordinal FOR UPDATE OF c
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.tool_output_capture SET file_operation_id=#{operation},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{capture} AND status='RESERVED' AND file_operation_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_tool_job_binding(id,operation_id,space_id,task_id,workspace_id,file_operation_id) SELECT #{id},operation_id,space_id,task_id,workspace_id,file_operation_id FROM pf.tool_output_capture WHERE id=#{capture} AND file_operation_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.tool_output_capture SET actual_bytes=#{bytes},content_sha256=#{hash},revision=revision+1 WHERE file_operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND status='CAPTURING' AND #{bytes}>=0 AND #{bytes}<=reserved_bytes AND (content_sha256 IS NULL OR(content_sha256=#{hash} AND actual_bytes=#{bytes}))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.asset_object(id,space_id,category,version_id,object_key,sha256,size_bytes,status,created_by) SELECT c.asset_id,c.space_id,'file-version',c.reserved_version_id,c.object_key,c.content_sha256,c.actual_bytes,'STAGING',o.actor_id FROM pf.tool_output_capture c JOIN pf.file_operation o ON o.id=c.file_operation_id AND o.space_id=c.space_id AND o.workspace_id=c.workspace_id WHERE o.id=#{command.operation.id} AND c.content_sha256 IS NOT NULL AND c.actual_bytes IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT(id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.tool_output_capture c JOIN pf.asset_object a ON a.id=c.asset_id AND a.space_id=c.space_id AND a.version_id=c.reserved_version_id AND a.sha256=c.content_sha256 AND a.size_bytes=c.actual_bytes AND a.object_key=c.object_key WHERE c.file_operation_id=#{command.operation.id})
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.tool_output_capture SET status='CAPTURING',revision=revision+1 WHERE file_operation_id=#{operation} AND status='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.tool_output_capture WHERE file_operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND space_id=#{command.operation.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{command.operation.workspaceId} AND helper_stop_hash=#{hash})
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.file_entry SET kind='FILE',current_version_id=#{row.versionId},collection_state='CONFIRMED', observed_sha256=#{row.sha256},observed_bytes=#{row.bytes},revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.fileId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{row.workspaceId}

UPDATE pf.asset_object SET status='AVAILABLE',revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{row.assetId} AND space_id=#{row.spaceId} AND version_id=#{row.versionId} AND sha256=#{row.sha256} AND size_bytes=#{row.bytes} AND status='STAGING'

UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-c.reserved_bytes,committed_bytes=s.committed_bytes+#{bytes},version=s.version+1 FROM pf.tool_output_capture c WHERE c.space_id=s.space_id AND c.file_operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND c.status IN('CAPTURING','RECONCILING') AND s.reserved_bytes>=c.reserved_bytes AND #{bytes}>=0 AND #{bytes}<=c.reserved_bytes

UPDATE pf.space_storage s SET reserved_bytes=s.reserved_bytes-c.reserved_bytes,version=s.version+1 FROM pf.tool_output_capture c WHERE c.space_id=s.space_id AND c.file_operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND c.status IN('CAPTURING','RECONCILING') AND s.reserved_bytes>=c.reserved_bytes AND c.content_sha256 IS NULL
UPDATE pf.tool_output_capture SET status='FAILED',revision=revision+1 WHERE file_operation_id=#{command.operation.id} AND status IN('CAPTURING','RECONCILING') AND content_sha256 IS NULL
UPDATE pf.tool_output_capture SET status='RECONCILING',revision=revision+1 WHERE file_operation_id=#{operation} AND status IN('RESERVED','CAPTURING')

UPDATE pf.file_entry SET collection_state='MISSING',revision=revision+1 WHERE space_id=#{space} AND workspace_id=#{workspace} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND left(relative_path,length(#{path})+1)=#{path}||'/' AND collection_state<>'MISSING'
